items.text:
subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 效果 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is the wet exterior brick wall and old vine in <Picture 1>, with wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture. <Picture 2> is the accepted opening frame for [Shot 1], fixing the approved starting composition, visible positions, and initial state for this shot.
summary: [keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. the last four leaves hold against a wet brick wall while one lower leaf is torn away by the wind. The opening is anchored by <Picture 2> and preserves <Subject 1>.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (reference image order 1): fully_preserved - its 效果 role is retained as the input reference for this shot. <Picture 2> (opening frame of [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the supplied starting composition, visible placement, and initial state open the shot. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture remain stable; the approved motion changes only the shot's stated action and endpoint.
detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. The shot begins from <Picture 2>. <Subject 1> fills the view beyond the studio window. From 0.00 to 1.60 seconds the camera stays locked in the approved vertical medium-long framing as cold dusk light and rain sheen reveal five separated leaves. From 1.60 to 3.60 seconds a gust travels laterally across the brick, the lowest leaf releases from its vine and drifts downward through the lower part of frame. From 3.60 to 5.00 seconds the camera holds on the wet wall: four leaves remain, and the final leaf stays in the upper-right position. The movement is one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: narrow top-floor artist studio with a tall rain-streaked window and exposed brick; final olive-green leaf on a wet brown vine.
overall_soundscape: Cold rain-muted room tone, wind scraping along the brick, and the soft flutter of the detached leaf. No human voice.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
